name: Bahia Palace
description: 19th-century grand palace featuring elaborate painted cedar ceilings, marble courtyards, and fragrant citrus gardens — just 200m from Riad Acacia.

name: Place Jemaa el-Fna
description: UNESCO World Heritage cultural square. Storytellers, musicians, fresh orange juice stalls, and vibrant open-air food stalls at dusk.

name: Koutoubia Mosque
description: Marrakech's iconic 77-meter 12th-century Almohad minaret that towers over the city skyline, surrounded by rose and orange gardens.

name: Musée Dar Si Said
description: National Museum of Weaving and Moroccan Arts housed in a sumptuous riad palace, only 120 meters (1.5 min walk) from your room.

name: Central Medina Souks
description: Labyrinthine artisan alleys: Souk Semmarine (fabrics & carpets), Souk el Attarine (brass & lanterns), and Souk des Teinturiers (dyers).

name: Riad Atlas Acacia Dining & Spa
description: Traditional 3-course Moroccan dinners by Hannane, rooftop jacuzzi & lounge, and authentic black soap hammam rituals right inside your riad.

name: Terrasse des Épices
description: Chic open-air rooftop restaurant overlooking Medina rooftops and Atlas mountains, serving refined Moroccan and international dishes.
best_time: Lunch or romantic dinner at sunset

name: Palais El Badi
description: Monumental ruins of Sultan Ahmad al-Mansur's 16th-century 'Incomparable Palace', featuring giant reflection pools and nesting storks.

name: Place des Ferblantiers & Le Mellah
description: Historic tin craftsmen square and Jewish quarter just 200m south. Famous for hand-pierced brass lanterns, natural spices, and herbalists.

name: Saadian Tombs
description: Mausoleum containing the tombs of the Saadian dynasty rulers with magnificent Italian Carrara marble carvings and honeycomb plasterwork.

name: Jardin Majorelle & Musée YSL
description: Jacques Majorelle's iconic cobalt blue villa surrounded by rare cacti and water lilies, restored by Yves Saint Laurent and Pierre Bergé.

name: Pharmacy Bahia
description: Nearest licensed pharmacy with qualified English and French speaking pharmacists, 100 meters down Rue Riad Zitoun Jdid.

name: ATM - Attijariwafa Bank & Currency Exchange
description: Reliable international ATM and official currency exchange counter accepting Visa, MasterCard, and foreign currency notes.

name: Official Petit Taxi Rank (Place des Ferblantiers)
description: Closest official taxi drop-off and pickup rank accessible by vehicle outside the pedestrian Medina alleys (3 min walk from riad).
